pages.name: Hollow
pages.text: $(bold)Threat:$() $(danger)high$(). Smoke-like entities that drift through walls and grab you.

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: $(li)Phases through all blocks$(li)Grab: Slowness IV, freeze buildup, then a $(danger)packed-ice tomb$()$(li)Immune to projectiles and freezing$(li)Half damage from non-Acheronite melee

pages.title: Counters
pages.text: $(li)Swing while grabbed to break free$(li)Fire and Acheronite weapons: full damage$(li)$(l:heating/frost_ward_torch)Frost Ward Torch$(/l): flee within 16 blocks$(li)Lit heaters burn them within 8 blocks

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Frozen Breath, for $(l:heating/cryo_fuel)Cryo Fuel$(/l) and $(l:heating/frost_ward_torch)Frost Ward Torches$(/l).$(br2)$(flavor)If you hear breathing behind you and nobody is there: run.$()
